prompts.object: Editorial still life photograph of a hand-built tabletop model made of paper, card, matte ceramic and brushed steel, photographed as a physical object on a plain pale surface, soft north-window light with long gentle shadows, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, matte film grade with lifted whites. Overhead still life of a tidy grid of six blank paint-swatch and paper-sample cards in whites and blues, matching spacing throughout, the grid filling the middle half of the frame. Subject centred with a quiet margin around it. Color palette: crisp white and pale mist-blue surfaces, deep blue and slate, soft grey. There is exactly one amber object in the frame: one small separate six-sided hexagon tile in amber glass resting on the central card. All other objects are white, grey, blue or slate. No text, no logos, no writing.
prompts.figure: Editorial documentary photograph of a calm working session around a hand-built tabletop model made of paper, card, matte ceramic and brushed steel, soft north-window daylight, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, matte film grade with lifted whites. Close-up at table height. The picture shows only one pair of forearms and hands, in a navy sweater, standing at a long pale table, one hand sliding a swatch card into place, in front of a tidy ordered grid of blank swatch cards with small hexagon die-cuts. The top edge of the photograph cuts through the middle of the torso, well below the collar. Subject centred with a quiet margin around it. Color palette: crisp white and pale mist-blue surfaces, deep blue and slate, soft grey. There is exactly one amber object in the frame: one swatch card of the grid in solid amber enamel. All other objects are white, grey, blue or slate. No text, no logos, no writing.
